title: Notification preferences
hint: Choose which notifications reach you, per type — as an in-app bell row, by email, or both. Everything is on by default.
masterSwitchHint: The master switch for the email column below — while it's off, no email goes out no matter what the per-type switches say.
noPermission: You may only change your own notification preferences
saveFailedNetwork: Saving failed — check your connection and try again
partialSaveFailed: The email switch was saved, but the per-type changes failed to save — please try again
